objective: Preallocate materialized CTE data keys from CTE name and row-id lengths.

tasks.title: Preallocate materialized CTE data keys
tasks.result: Materialized CTE row writes now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for temporary data keys.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for data:<cte>:<row_id> before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in materialized CTE temporary row writes.
Generated key bytes, row-cache invalidation keys, CTE cleanup prefixes, recursive CTE replacement, and SQL results are unchanged.
Focused CTE tests were launched in parallel and printed Cargo file-lock wait messages before passing.
